about: BK-16 PR 2 (P-496 (1), (A3), tech lead on #1632): the four configured-checkpoint combinations other than the Study permit, captured from main 92507436d (12 Nov 2026) on a fresh isolated copy that loaded the configured checkpoint (saved AI answers, US$0). Per combination: release_fingerprint, its release's sha256 (engine/snapshot.ts snapshotHash; status is not in it); snapshot_sha256, the sha256 of the WHOLE release snapshot, canonical, with the status of the items in status_may_differ ignored (tests/lib/release-snapshot-compare.ts); status_may_differ, the 37 shared library items the Study permit's release now carries first (IMM 1295 reuses their questions), so they read PUBLISHED where main reads DRAFT; and the readable placements, sections and form lines, for a failure's words. tests/check_bk16_family_forms_api.ts compares the head's latest releases with it: any other difference fails. Re-capture from main only when a merged row changes these releases on purpose, and say why in that row.
